ValidationRule.description: LFRDN-636: Inventory Status is a Keyloop-mastered mirror and should never be hand-edited in Salesforce (SD p.65). Blocks changes to AF_InventoryStatus__c unless the user holds AF_CanBypassInventorySync.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Inventory Status is synced automatically from Keyloop and cannot be edited directly in Salesforce. If this is a deliberate manual correction, ask an administrator to apply the "Bypass Inventory Sync Protection" permission first.
